title: Report: Progressive Disclosure of Agent Skills
title_zh: 报告: 渐进披露代理技能的影响

paragraphs.en: Users of Workday’s deployed LLM-based agents often request features which can be addressed by defining named procedures, also known as skills, in the LLM context, effectively augmenting agents’ capabilities. However, as an agent’s skills library grows in size, so does the agent’s operational cost. Progressive disclosure (lazy-loading) of skills as needed may reduce operational costs, but its impact on overall latency and skill-retrieval quality remains unclear. In this report, we investigate the impact empirically and find that progressive disclosure improves skill-retrieval quality but marginally degrades overall latency.
paragraphs.zh: Workday 已部署的基于 LLM 的智能体的用户经常请求一些功能，这些功能可以通过在 LLM 上下文中定义命名程序（也称为“技能”）来实现，从而有效增强智能体的能力。 然而，随着智能体的技能库规模不断扩大，其运行成本也随之增加。 按需逐步披露（延迟加载）技能或许能降低运行成本，但这对整体延迟和技能检索质量的影响尚不明确。 在本报告中，我们通过实证研究探讨了这一影响，发现逐步披露能够提升技能检索质量，但对整体延迟的负面影响微乎其微。

paragraphs.en: Workday 1 1 1 https://www.workday.com/ is a cloud-based enterprise platform for managing people, money and agents, serving over 65% of Fortune 500 enterprises. As of August 2026, over 5,500 of our customers are using one or more AI agents deployed in the Workday platform, a 35% increase compared to the previous quarter.

paragraphs.en: As more customers adopt our deployed LLM-based agents, it is necessary to adapt their agentic capabilities in response to feature requests and bug reports. A simple and effective approach for enhancing agentic capabilities is to define specialized instructions detailing how a particular feature request or bug report may be addressed. Modern agent frameworks, such as LangChain, package those instructions as skills . Skills package domain expertise, such as workflows, best practices, scripts, reference docs, and templates, into reusable directories. Each skill has a name, a natural-language description, an input/output signature, and often a worked example or usage notes.
paragraphs.zh: 随着更多客户采用我们部署的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体，有必要根据功能请求和错误报告调整这些智能体的能力。 提升智能体能力的一种简单而有效的方法，是制定专门的说明，详细说明如何响应特定的功能请求或错误报告。 现代智能体框架（如 LangChain）将这些说明封装为“技能”。 “技能”将领域专业知识（例如工作流程、最佳实践、脚本、参考文档和模板）整合到可重用的目录中。 每个技能都包含一个名称、自然语言描述、输入/输出定义，通常还附带一个示例或使用说明。

sents.en: As more customers adopt our deployed LLM-based agents, it is necessary to adapt their agentic capabilities in response to feature requests and bug reports.

paragraphs.en: In order to enable an agent’s underlying large language model (LLM) to faithfully follow the instructions in a skill’s definition, the ‘eager loading’ skill management regime fully discloses the skill in the LLM prompt context. However, as an agent’s skills library grows in size, we observe a notable increase in its operational costs, due to the number of tokens used to disclose the skills library in the LLM context, which prompted us to explore alternative regimes for managing agent skills.
paragraphs.zh: 为了让智能体底层的大语言模型（LLM）能够忠实遵循技能定义中的指令，“急切加载”的技能管理机制会在 LLM 提示上下文中完整披露该技能。 然而，随着智能体的技能库规模不断扩大，我们观察到其运行成本显著上升，这是因为在 LLM 上下文中披露整个技能库所需的 token 数量随之增加，这促使我们探索替代的智能体技能管理方案。

sents.en: In order to enable an agent’s underlying large language model (LLM) to faithfully follow the instructions in a skill’s definition, the ‘eager loading’ skill management regime fully discloses the skill in the LLM prompt context.
sents.zh: 为了让智能体底层的大语言模型（LLM）能够忠实遵循技能定义中的指令，“急切加载”的技能管理机制会在 LLM 提示上下文中完整披露该技能。

sents.en: However, as an agent’s skills library grows in size, we observe a notable increase in its operational costs, due to the number of tokens used to disclose the skills library in the LLM context, which prompted us to explore alternative regimes for managing agent skills.
sents.zh: 然而，随着智能体的技能库规模不断扩大，我们观察到其运行成本显著上升，这是因为在 LLM 上下文中披露整个技能库所需的 token 数量随之增加，这促使我们探索替代的智能体技能管理方案。

paragraphs.en: Lazy loading of skill definitions as needed, also known as progressive disclosure, is an attractive alternative, commonly adopted in agentic frameworks such as LangChain. When progressive disclosure is enabled, agents incrementally disclose skills in the LLM context, pulling in more details only as a task calls for it.
paragraphs.zh: 按需懒加载技能定义，也称为渐进式披露，是一种颇具吸引力的替代方案，在 LangChain 等智能体框架中得到了广泛应用。 启用渐进式披露后，智能体会逐步在 LLM 上下文中披露技能，仅在任务需要时才会引入更多细节。

sents.en: Lazy loading of skill definitions as needed, also known as progressive disclosure, is an attractive alternative, commonly adopted in agentic frameworks such as LangChain.
sents.zh: 按需懒加载技能定义，也称为渐进式披露，是一种颇具吸引力的替代方案，在 LangChain 等智能体框架中得到了广泛应用。

sents.en: When progressive disclosure is enabled, agents incrementally disclose skills in the LLM context, pulling in more details only as a task calls for it.
sents.zh: 启用渐进式披露后，智能体会逐步在 LLM 上下文中披露技能，仅在任务需要时才会引入更多细节。

paragraphs.en: In this report, we investigate the tradeoffs of activating progressive disclosure of skills in the agent harness, measuring how it impacts an agent’s overall token-based operational cost, latency and skill-retrieval quality, as the library size grows in a controlled setup. Next, we describe our implementation for progressive disclosure.
paragraphs.zh: 在本报告中，我们通过受控实验研究了在智能体框架中启用技能渐进式披露所带来的权衡问题，测量了随着库规模扩大，这种做法对智能体整体基于标记的运营成本、延迟以及技能检索质量的影响。 接下来，我们将描述我们实现渐进式披露的具体方案。

sents.en: In this report, we investigate the tradeoffs of activating progressive disclosure of skills in the agent harness, measuring how it impacts an agent’s overall token-based operational cost, latency and skill-retrieval quality, as the library size grows in a controlled setup.
sents.zh: 在本报告中，我们通过受控实验研究了在智能体框架中启用技能渐进式披露所带来的权衡问题，测量了随着库规模扩大，这种做法对智能体整体基于标记的运营成本、延迟以及技能检索质量的影响。

sents.en: Next, we describe our implementation for progressive disclosure.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将描述我们实现渐进式披露的具体方案。

paragraphs.en: A minimal agent consists of an LLM core and its harness. 2 2 2 It is not uncommon for one agent to utilize multiple LLMs for different subtasks. The harness interfaces with the agent’s environment, determines when to invoke the LLM, manages the skills library, prepares the context (and prompt) before invoking the LLM, and processes LLM outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 一个最小智能体由一个 LLM 核心及其配套机制组成。2 2 2 一个智能体使用多个 LLM 来处理不同子任务的情况并不少见。 该配套机制与智能体的环境进行交互，决定何时调用 LLM，管理技能库，在调用 LLM 前准备上下文（和提示），并处理 LLM 的输出。

sents.en: A minimal agent consists of an LLM core and its harness. 2 2 2 It is not uncommon for one agent to utilize multiple LLMs for different subtasks.
sents.zh: 一个最小智能体由一个 LLM 核心及其配套机制组成。2 2 2 一个智能体使用多个 LLM 来处理不同子任务的情况并不少见。

sents.en: The harness interfaces with the agent’s environment, determines when to invoke the LLM, manages the skills library, prepares the context (and prompt) before invoking the LLM, and processes LLM outputs.
sents.zh: 该配套机制与智能体的环境进行交互，决定何时调用 LLM，管理技能库，在调用 LLM 前准备上下文（和提示），并处理 LLM 的输出。

paragraphs.en: An agent’s skills library consists of N N structured skills. According to the open standard format for Agent Skills, each skill is a directory containing, at minimum, a SKILL.md file starting with the skill’s frontmatter (a name field and a description field in YAML), followed by the skill’s body content which contains the operative content in Markdown, e.g., step-by-step instructions, input-output examples and edge cases. 3 3 3 The frontmatter may also include optional fields such as license , compatibility and metadata . See https://agentskills.io for more details on the Agent Skills open standard. Instead of manually creating all skill content from scratch, coding agents such as Claude Code can be used to create and modify specialized skills and it is not uncommon for agent developers to share the skills they define in version-controlled repositories in order for them to be reused in multiple agents and by other developers. 4 4 4 See https://officialskills.sh/ for example skill repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的技能库由 N 个结构化技能组成。 根据“智能体技能”开放标准格式，每个技能都是一个目录，其中至少包含一个以技能的前置元数据（YAML 格式的名称字段和描述字段）开头的 SKILL.md 文件，其后是技能的主体内容，以 Markdown 格式呈现操作内容，例如分步说明、输入输出示例和边界情况。 前置元数据还可以包含许可、兼容性和元数据等可选字段。 如需了解更多关于“智能体技能”开放标准的详细信息，请访问 https://agentskills.io。

sents.en: An agent’s skills library consists of N N structured skills.
sents.zh: 智能体的技能库由 N 个结构化技能组成。

sents.en: According to the open standard format for Agent Skills, each skill is a directory containing, at minimum, a SKILL.md file starting with the skill’s frontmatter (a name field and a description field in YAML), followed by the skill’s body content which contains the operative content in Markdown, e.g., step-by-step instructions, input-output examples and edge cases. 3 3 3 The frontmatter may also include optional fields such as license , compatibility and metadata .

sents.en: See https://agentskills.io for more details on the Agent Skills open standard.
sents.zh: 前置元数据还可以包含许可、兼容性和元数据等可选字段。

sents.en: Instead of manually creating all skill content from scratch, coding agents such as Claude Code can be used to create and modify specialized skills and it is not uncommon for agent developers to share the skills they define in version-controlled repositories in order for them to be reused in multiple agents and by other developers. 4 4 4 See https://officialskills.sh/ for example skill repositories.
sents.zh: 如需了解更多关于“智能体技能”开放标准的详细信息，请访问 https://agentskills.io。

paragraphs.en: A naïve regime an agent harness may use is to port all details of all N N skills in its library to the LLM context, which we call ‘eager loading’ of skills. As the number of skills increase, eager loading substantially increases the number of tokens needed to disclose skills in the LLM context, which impacts the agent’s quality, reliability and cost. An alternative regime loads skills progressively, disclosing minimal information about available skills in the LLM context early on and adding more details about the most relevant skills in subsequent LLM invocations only when a task calls for it, also known as ‘progressive disclosure’. In this report, we contrast eager loading with a regime that loads the frontmatter of all N N skills in the LLM context and prompts the LLM core to emit a structured command which determines which skill is most relevant for the task at hand, e.g., {"action":"load_skill","name":"pptx"} . The harness then loads the body content of the chosen skill to the LLM context in subsequent LLM invocations. 5 5 5 Note that this implementation requires additional invocations to the LLM core, but reduces the number of tokens used in the LLM context.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体框架可能采用的一种简单方案是，将其库中所有 N 个技能的完整细节都传入 LLM 上下文，我们称之为技能的“急切加载”。 随着技能数量的增加，急切加载会显著增大在 LLM 上下文中披露技能所需的令牌数量，从而影响智能体的质量、可靠性和成本。 另一种方案是渐进式加载技能：在初始阶段仅向 LLM 上下文披露可用技能的最低限度信息，并在后续 LLM 调用中，只有当任务需要时，才添加与任务最相关的技能的更多细节，这也被称为“渐进式披露”。 在本报告中，我们将急切加载与另一种方案进行比较：该方案将所有 N 个技能的前置元数据传入 LLM 上下文，并提示 LLM 核心生成一个结构化命令，以确定哪项技能与当前任务最相关，例如：{"action":"load_skill","name":"pptx"}。 随后，框架会在后续的 LLM 调用中，将所选技能的主体内容加载到 LLM 上下文中。注意，这种实现需要向 LLM 核心发起额外的调用，但能减少 LLM 上下文中的令牌使用量。

sents.zh: 智能体框架可能采用的一种简单方案是，将其库中所有 N 个技能的完整细节都传入 LLM 上下文，我们称之为技能的“急切加载”。

sents.en: The harness then loads the body content of the chosen skill to the LLM context in subsequent LLM invocations. 5 5 5 Note that this implementation requires additional invocations to the LLM core, but reduces the number of tokens used in the LLM context.
sents.zh: 随后，框架会在后续的 LLM 调用中，将所选技能的主体内容加载到 LLM 上下文中。注意，这种实现需要向 LLM 核心发起额外的调用，但能减少 LLM 上下文中的令牌使用量。

paragraphs.en: We estimate the impact of progressive disclosure by measuring skill-retrieval success rate, total tokens used and overall latency in seconds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过衡量技能检索成功率、总令牌使用量以及以秒为单位的总体延迟，来评估渐进式披露的影响。

paragraphs.en: The impact of progressive disclosure on an agent’s quality is mediated by its ability to select relevant skills, which we quantify using an explicit skill-retrieval task. We augment the body content of each skill with a unique ‘activation code’ identifier, produced by a random number generator. Each instance of the task names a domain intent (e.g., travel) and asks the agent to return the most relevant activation code in a structured response which takes the form: RESULT[<skill-name>]: <activation-code> . The agent harness delegates the task to the LLM core, which is only able to return the correct activation code if the relevant skill’s body is loaded in its context. We define a taxonomy of outcomes:
paragraphs.zh: 渐进式披露对智能体质量的影响，取决于其选择相关技能的能力，而这一能力我们通过一个显式的技能检索任务进行量化。 我们为每个技能的主体内容添加了一个唯一的“激活码”标识符，该标识符由随机数生成器产生。 任务的每个实例都会指定一个领域意图（例如，旅行），并要求智能体以结构化响应返回最相关的激活码，格式为：RESULT[<技能名称>]: <激活码>。 智能体框架将任务委托给 LLM 核心，而只有当相关技能的主体内容被加载到其上下文中时，该核心才能返回正确的激活码。 我们定义了一套结果分类体系：

sents.en: The impact of progressive disclosure on an agent’s quality is mediated by its ability to select relevant skills, which we quantify using an explicit skill-retrieval task.
sents.zh: 渐进式披露对智能体质量的影响，取决于其选择相关技能的能力，而这一能力我们通过一个显式的技能检索任务进行量化。

sents.zh: 我们为每个技能的主体内容添加了一个唯一的“激活码”标识符，该标识符由随机数生成器产生。

sents.en: Each instance of the task names a domain intent (e.g., travel) and asks the agent to return the most relevant activation code in a structured response which takes the form: RESULT[<skill-name>]: <activation-code> .
sents.zh: 任务的每个实例都会指定一个领域意图（例如，旅行），并要求智能体以结构化响应返回最相关的激活码，格式为：RESULT[<技能名称>]: <激活码>。

sents.en: The agent harness delegates the task to the LLM core, which is only able to return the correct activation code if the relevant skill’s body is loaded in its context.
sents.zh: 智能体框架将任务委托给 LLM 核心，而只有当相关技能的主体内容被加载到其上下文中时，该核心才能返回正确的激活码。

sents.en: We define a taxonomy of outcomes:
sents.zh: 我们定义了一套结果分类体系：

paragraphs.en: success (skill name and activation code are both correct),
paragraphs.zh: 成功（技能名称和激活码均正确），

paragraphs.en: wrong_code (skill name is correct, but the activation code is wrong), and
paragraphs.zh: 错误代码（技能名称正确，但激活代码错误），以及

paragraphs.en: crash (context overflow or malformed output).
paragraphs.zh: 崩溃（上下文溢出或输出格式错误）。

paragraphs.en: We experiment with four library sizes: N ∈ { 5 , 20 , 50 , 100 } N\in\{5,20,50,100\} , and develop a core set of 24 24 task instances based on 5 5 relevant skills. For N > 5 N>5 , we pad the skills library with distractor skills with three difficulty tiers that vary the directness of the trigger phrasing, drawn from a generator spanning 12 12 domain families. We use three different seeds for each task, and report means over 72 72 rollouts for each unique combination of library size N N and skill management regime (i.e., eager loading vs. progressive disclosure).
paragraphs.zh: 我们实验了四种库大小：N ∈ { 5 , 20 , 50 , 100 } N\in\{5,20,50,100\}，并基于 5 个相关技能开发了一个包含 24 个任务实例的核心集合。 对于 N > 5 的情况，我们通过添加三个难度级别的干扰技能来扩充技能库，这些技能通过一个涵盖 12 个领域家族的生成器，改变了触发短语的直接性。 我们为每个任务使用三种不同的种子，并对每种库大小 N 和技能管理方案（即即时加载与渐进式揭示）的唯一组合，报告 72 次运行结果的平均值。

sents.en: We use three different seeds for each task, and report means over 72 72 rollouts for each unique combination of library size N N and skill management regime (i.e., eager loading vs. progressive disclosure).
sents.zh: 我们为每个任务使用三种不同的种子，并对每种库大小 N 和技能管理方案（即即时加载与渐进式揭示）的唯一组合，报告 72 次运行结果的平均值。

paragraphs.en: We experiment with three LLM cores: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen Team 2024 ) , Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B ( Qwen Team 2025 ) , with greedy decoding and a 32 32 k context window. 6 6 6 Qwen3 models run in non-thinking mode. For each LLM core, we run 576 576 agent rollouts, which correspond to 4 4 library sizes × 2 \times\ 2 skill management regimes × 24 \times\ 24 task instances × 3 \times\ 3 seeds. We use vLLM ( Kwon et al. 2023 ) on a single NVIDIA L40S (48 GB) to serve all LLM cores. Every core LLM invocation passes through a wrapper that records prompt tokens count, completion tokens count, and wall-clock latency from the server’s usage accounting. 7 7 7 We report per-task totals summed over all calls in a rollout, so the extra load_skill LLM invocations used when progressive disclosure is enabled are accounted for.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用三种大型语言模型（LLM）核心进行实验：Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（Qwen Team 2024）、Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-14B（Qwen Team 2025），并采用贪心解码和 32k 上下文窗口。6 个 Qwen3 模型以非思考模式运行。 对于每个 LLM 核心，我们执行 576 次智能体滚动运行，这对应于 4 种库大小 × 2 种技能管理方案 × 24 个任务实例 × 3 个随机种子。 我们在单台 NVIDIA L40S（48 GB）上使用 vLLM（Kwon et al. 2023）来服务所有 LLM 核心。 每个核心 LLM 的调用都会经过一个包装器，该包装器会记录提示词令牌数、完成令牌数以及服务器使用统计中的实际运行延迟。7 我们报告的是每次任务在所有滚动运行调用中的总和，因此当启用渐进式披露时所使用的额外 load_skill LLM 调用也会被计入其中。

paragraphs.en: When eager loading is enabled, skill definitions increasingly dominate the context as N N grows, eventually breaking the agent’s reliability due to exceeding the maximum allowed prompt size, indicated by crash in all rollouts with N = 100 N=100 in Table 1 (Eager tok) and Figure 2 (c). Table 1 (Tok ↓ \downarrow ) shows the percentage of tokens saved when progressive disclosure is enabled, demonstrating savings across all values of N N , as intended, as a direct result of only disclosing the full body of the most relevant skill in progressive disclosure. Progressive disclosure demonstrates increasingly bigger token savings as N N grows, up to 81.7 % 81.7\% of tokens originally used in the eager loading regime. Figure 2 (a) visually demonstrates how token usage grows as a function of library size in both regimes. With the prevalent token-based pricing of LLMs, these savings translate to substantial savings of agents’ operational cost at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 当启用急切加载时，随着 N 的增长，技能定义在上下文中的占比会越来越高，最终因超出允许的最大提示长度而破坏智能体的可靠性；表 1（Eager tok）和图 2(c) 中所有 N = 100 的运行实例均出现崩溃，即为此例。 表 1（Tok ↓ \downarrow）显示了启用渐进式披露时节省的令牌百分比，结果表明在所有 N 值下都实现了预期中的节省，这是渐进式披露仅披露最相关技能的完整内容的直接结果。 随着 N 的增长，渐进式披露带来的令牌节省量也持续增加，最高可达急切加载模式下原始令牌使用量的 81.7%（81.7\%）。 图 2(a) 直观展示了两种模式下令牌使用量如何随库规模变化而增长。 鉴于 LLM 普遍采用基于令牌的定价模式，这些节省意味着在大规模部署时，智能体的运行成本将显著降低。

sents.zh: 鉴于 LLM 普遍采用基于令牌的定价模式，这些节省意味着在大规模部署时，智能体的运行成本将显著降低。

paragraphs.en: As we described earlier, the progressive disclosure regime for skill management entails an additional LLM invocation dedicated to identifying relevant skills, which often increases the agent’s mean overall latency, as illustrated in Figure 1 (c). For example, using progressive disclosure instead of eager loading corresponds to a 15 % 15\% increase in the agent’s overall latency (from 1.75 1.75 to 2.01 2.01 seconds) when using Qwen3-8B with a library of size N = 50 N{=}50 . 8 8 8 We note that the delta reduces as N N grows, which may reverse this result for a larger prompt token budget. Depending on task complexity, an agent may amortize the latency associated with extra LLM invocations in progressive disclosure over more subtasks which may also reverse this result.
paragraphs.zh: 如前所述，技能管理的渐进式披露机制需要额外调用一次大语言模型（LLM）来识别相关技能，这通常会增加智能体的平均总延迟，如图 1(c) 所示。 例如，与立即加载相比，使用渐进式披露会使智能体的总延迟增加 15%（从 1.75 秒增至 2.01 秒），这是在使用 Qwen3-8B 且库大小为 N = 50 时的结果。我们注意到，随着 N 的增大，这一差异会减小，在提示词令牌预算更大的情况下，这一结果可能会反转。 根据任务的复杂程度，智能体可能通过将其分配到更多子任务中来分摊渐进式披露所涉及的额外 LLM 调用带来的延迟，这也可能导致上述结果发生反转。

paragraphs.en: While progressive disclosure is the undisputed winner on average skill retrieval quality, neither regime consistently outperforms the other, as shown in Figure 2 (b). Progressive disclosure either matches or outperforms eager loading on average skill-retrieval quality in all but one experimental setup, as shown in Table 1 (Skill retrieval). As the library size N N grows, distractor skills dominate the LLM context, and the skill-retrieval quality for the eager loading regime falls sharply (e.g., from 1.00 1.00 at N = 5 N{=}5 to 0.125 0.125 at N = 50 N{=}50 for Qwen3-14B), exposing retrieval of the wrong skill name as the dominant failure as shown in Figure 1 (a). 9 9 9 Levy, Jacoby, and Goldberg (2024) also report degradation in reasoning quality as the LLM prompt size increases. We note that the largest LLM core (Qwen3-14B) is resilient against easy/medium distractors but remains susceptible to hard distractors, as shown in Figure 1 (b). This finding emphasizes the importance of developing skill management regimes which do not only optimize for token usage but also skill retrieval quality.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管渐进式披露在平均技能检索质量方面无可争议地胜出，但如图 2(b) 所示，这两种机制并未有一方始终优于另一方。 除了一种实验设置外，渐进式披露在所有实验设置中的平均技能检索质量都至少与即时加载相当，甚至更优，如表 1（技能检索）所示。 随着库大小 N 的增长，干扰性技能会占据 LLM 上下文，即时加载机制的技能检索质量会急剧下降（例如，对于 Qwen3-14B，从 N = 5 时的 1.00 降至 N = 50 时的 0.125），暴露出错误检索技能名称是主要失败原因，如图 1(a) 所示。Levy、Jacoby 和 Goldberg（2024）也报告称，随着 LLM 提示长度的增加，推理质量也会下降。 我们注意到，最大的 LLM 核心（Qwen3-14B）对简单/中等难度的干扰项具有抵抗力，但仍容易受到高难度干扰项的影响，如图 1(b) 所示。 这一发现强调了开发技能管理机制的重要性，这些机制不应仅优化令牌使用，还应兼顾技能检索质量。

paragraphs.en: Skills have emerged as an effective way of augmenting agentic capabilities in response to increasing adoption of production agents. Progressive disclosure declares the frontmatter (a skill’s name and brief description) of all skills available to an agent in the initial LLM context then incrementally loads the full definition of relevant skills as needed, instead of naïvely loading the full definitions of all skills. In this report, we found that progressive disclosure of agent skills reduces token usage and improve reliability as well as skill-retrieval quality, at the expense of greater latency.
paragraphs.zh: 随着生产型智能体的应用日益广泛，技能已成为增强智能体能力的一种有效方式。 渐进式披露机制首先会在初始 LLM 上下文中声明智能体可访问的所有技能的前置信息（即技能名称和简要描述），随后根据需求逐步加载相关技能的完整定义，而不是直接加载所有技能的完整定义。 在本报告中，我们发现渐进式披露智能体技能能够减少令牌使用量、提升可靠性和技能检索质量，但会伴随更高的延迟。

sents.en: Skills have emerged as an effective way of augmenting agentic capabilities in response to increasing adoption of production agents.
sents.zh: 随着生产型智能体的应用日益广泛，技能已成为增强智能体能力的一种有效方式。

sents.en: Progressive disclosure declares the frontmatter (a skill’s name and brief description) of all skills available to an agent in the initial LLM context then incrementally loads the full definition of relevant skills as needed, instead of naïvely loading the full definitions of all skills.
sents.zh: 渐进式披露机制首先会在初始 LLM 上下文中声明智能体可访问的所有技能的前置信息（即技能名称和简要描述），随后根据需求逐步加载相关技能的完整定义，而不是直接加载所有技能的完整定义。

sents.en: In this report, we found that progressive disclosure of agent skills reduces token usage and improve reliability as well as skill-retrieval quality, at the expense of greater latency.
sents.zh: 在本报告中，我们发现渐进式披露智能体技能能够减少令牌使用量、提升可靠性和技能检索质量，但会伴随更高的延迟。

paragraphs.en: The experimental setup discussed earlier limits skill retrieval to one skill for each task. In practice, the agent has no prior knowledge about the number of skills needed for a given task. How do we balance the verbosity of skill definitions with the complexity of the task at hand remains an open research question in agent skill management with critical consequences.
paragraphs.zh: 前面讨论的实验设置将技能检索限制为每个任务仅使用一项技能。 在实际应用中，智能体对完成特定任务所需的技能数量没有先验知识。 如何在技能定义的详尽性与当前任务的复杂性之间取得平衡，仍然是智能体技能管理领域一个具有关键影响性的开放研究问题。

sents.en: The experimental setup discussed earlier limits skill retrieval to one skill for each task.
sents.zh: 前面讨论的实验设置将技能检索限制为每个任务仅使用一项技能。

sents.en: In practice, the agent has no prior knowledge about the number of skills needed for a given task.
sents.zh: 在实际应用中，智能体对完成特定任务所需的技能数量没有先验知识。

sents.en: How do we balance the verbosity of skill definitions with the complexity of the task at hand remains an open research question in agent skill management with critical consequences.
sents.zh: 如何在技能定义的详尽性与当前任务的复杂性之间取得平衡，仍然是智能体技能管理领域一个具有关键影响性的开放研究问题。

paragraphs.en: The experimental setup discussed earlier limits the definition of each skill in the library to its SKILL.md file. In practice, a skill’s directory may also contain additional files (e.g., scripts, references or assets) which would take up even more room in the LLM context. What strategies do we use to determine which files to load? How do we evaluate the efficacy of different strategies in practice?
paragraphs.zh: 前面讨论的实验设置将知识库中每个技能的定义限制在其 SKILL.md 文件中。 实际上，一个技能的目录也可能包含其他文件（例如脚本、参考材料或资源），这些文件会进一步占用 LLM 上下文空间。 我们采用哪些策略来决定加载哪些文件？ 在实践中，我们如何评估不同策略的有效性？

sents.en: The experimental setup discussed earlier limits the definition of each skill in the library to its SKILL.md file.
sents.zh: 前面讨论的实验设置将知识库中每个技能的定义限制在其 SKILL.md 文件中。

sents.en: In practice, a skill’s directory may also contain additional files (e.g., scripts, references or assets) which would take up even more room in the LLM context.
sents.zh: 实际上，一个技能的目录也可能包含其他文件（例如脚本、参考材料或资源），这些文件会进一步占用 LLM 上下文空间。

sents.en: What strategies do we use to determine which files to load?
sents.zh: 我们采用哪些策略来决定加载哪些文件？

sents.en: How do we evaluate the efficacy of different strategies in practice?
sents.zh: 在实践中，我们如何评估不同策略的有效性？

paragraphs.en: With increased adoption of skill libraries, agent developers may accidentally include serious vulnerabilities hidden in skill definitions. How do we effectively monitor an agent’s risk exposure as a result of including a skill in its library?
paragraphs.zh: 随着技能库的采用日益广泛，智能体开发者可能会无意中引入隐藏在技能定义中的严重漏洞。 当某个技能被纳入智能体的技能库时，我们如何有效监控由此带来的风险暴露？

sents.en: With increased adoption of skill libraries, agent developers may accidentally include serious vulnerabilities hidden in skill definitions.
sents.zh: 随着技能库的采用日益广泛，智能体开发者可能会无意中引入隐藏在技能定义中的严重漏洞。

sents.en: How do we effectively monitor an agent’s risk exposure as a result of including a skill in its library?
sents.zh: 当某个技能被纳入智能体的技能库时，我们如何有效监控由此带来的风险暴露？
